verdict.rationale: Postman docs show you can write post-response test scripts that validate the API response (docs-12, docs-17, docs-29, docs-30). These tests run from the Postman CLI or Newman in CI (docs-19, docs-42), and a community user calls Postman invaluable for validating APIs (comm-20). missing for 10: explicit documentation of assertions against status codes, response body fields, and headers specifically; documentation of the assertion API/library; independent hands-on corroboration of assertion depth.
